newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras cut. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras cut. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]

text.p: HSBC James Capel analyst Paul Aran cut his rating for Brazilian telephone holding Telebras SA Monday to long-term buy from buy.
-- He said in a report that the company had reached his price target.

-- "Telebras has announced that its subsidiaries will sell new shares worth almost two billion reais," he wrote. "We understand that TBR will not be participating in this issuance and that its stake in its subsidiaries will therefore decline by approximately five percent.

-- "Because of this dilution we are adjusting our mid-year 1998 price target to $173 from an otherwise $182 (corrects from $192) per ADR (American Depositary Receipt). We have adjusted our model downwards to $10.11 for 1997 from $10.91 and to $12.15 from $12.93.
-- "Our earnings estimates will be further reduced to reflect the five percent dilution once it takes place," Aran wrote.
-- Telebras ADRs opened down one to 153-3/8 in New York.
((-- Ian Simpson, Wall Street desk, 212 859-1879)) (c) Reuters Limited 1997
